about_the_game:
In this game, you control a man who, upon waking in the shadows, is horrified to find himself trapped in his own hotel. Every door he opens leads him back to the same eerie hallway, as if the place is toying with his mind. As you unravel the story and piece together fragments of his past, you'll discover that the only way out involves uncovering a dark ancestral ritual and facing your deepest fears.

Immerse yourself in a claustrophobic world where every step builds tension and every shadow hides a crucial clue. Solve intricate puzzles inspired by both classic and modern riddles, challenge your wits, and make choices that affect the outcome of this terrifying journey.

Key Features:

  • High-detail retro graphics with a truly immersive suspenseful atmosphere

  • Smooth controls and first-person 3D movement for a deep, engaging experience

  • A wide variety of puzzles with increasing difficulty that test your logic

  • Thick, immersive fog, distant echoes, and spine-chilling sounds to raise your nerves

  • Non-linear narrative with hidden clues requiring sharp attention to detail

  • Quick save system and strategic checkpoints to keep the experience flowing

Step into this sinister world, challenge your mind, and uncover the darkest secrets of this cursed hotel. Will you have the courage to complete the ritual and escape… or remain trapped within its walls forever?
